title: Loadstones
description: Create a Chunkloader by dropping an Ender Pearl on a Lodestone!
body:
## **Have you ever played on an SMP where enderperls weren't allowed, but you still wanted the Enderpearl-Chunkloaders? Well...**

### The VanillaTweaks Chunk Loaders Pack, but with an Ender Pearl instead of a Nether Star! 
Great for SMP's that see Ender Pearls as overpowered but still want to use the Chunkloading ability!
